candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
Heh: "Security of energy supply has in fact become so important that even the Asia Zero Emission Community, headed by Japan, has redirected its focus from emissions to oil supply."

This won't help oil plunge to pre-war levels if/when peace breaks out... and they're not alone.

candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
DOE: 70 million barrels to keep oil in the pipes, pumps, valves, etc.

Most experts: 100-150 million for system integrity. (Second guess: up to 300 million.)

Whatever the minimum is, that floor shouldn't be seen as part of the reserve, but as part of the infrastructure.
